## Checklist

- [ ] The title and the commit start with the task ID, for example `NOR-F2-01: what changed`, or with a short description if it is not a roadmap task
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests, `rust:check`)
- [ ] New behavior has tests (Vitest, `cargo test`, or Playwright when it needs the interface)
- [ ] No new dependency, or the reason and its license (on the allowed list) are written below
- [ ] No `node_modules`, `target`, `dist`, binaries, `.env` or secrets in the diff
- [ ] Docs and interface text are updated when behavior changed
